# 测试代码模板集

> 本文件包含 OpenHarmony Lite 8种外设的完整测试代码模板，覆盖 L0（HCTest+iCunit混合模式）和 L1-Linux（HWTest/gtest模式），含正向/异常/边界/CMSIS兼容性测试。

---

## 1. HCTest 单元测试通用模板

```c
/*
```

## 2. GPIO 驱动完整测试示例（Hi3861）

### 2.1 测试头文件和公共定义

```c
/* gpio_driver_test.h - Hi3861 GPIO驱动测试 */
#ifndef GPIO_DRIVER_TEST_H
#define GPIO_DRIVER_TEST_H

#include "hctest.h"
#include "gpio_if.h"
#include "iot_gpio.h"

/* Hi3861 GPIO 引脚范围: 0-21 */
#define TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID      5
#define TEST_GPIO_PIN_ALT        10
#define TEST_GPIO_PIN_INVALID    99
#define TEST_GPIO_VALUE_HIGH     1
#define TEST_GPIO_VALUE_LOW      0

#endif /* GPIO_DRIVER_TEST_H */
```

### 2.2 正向功能测试

```c
/* gpio_driver_positive_test.c - Hi3861 GPIO正向测试 */
#include "gpio_driver_test.h"

/**
 * @brief 验证 GPIO 正常打开和关闭
 */
static void TestGpioOpenClose(void) {
    int32_t ret = GpioOpen(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    ret = GpioClose(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);
}

/**
 * @brief 验证设置 GPIO 为输入方向
 */
static void TestGpioSetDirInput(void) {
    GpioOpen(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);

    int32_t ret = GpioSetDir(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, GPIO_DIR_IN);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    enum GpioDir dir;
    ret = GpioGetDir(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, &dir);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(GPIO_DIR_IN, dir);

    GpioClose(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);
}

/**
 * @brief 验证设置 GPIO 为输出方向并写入读取
 */
static void TestGpioWriteRead(void) {
    GpioOpen(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);
    GpioSetDir(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, GPIO_DIR_OUT);

    /* 写高电平 */
    int32_t ret = GpioWrite(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, TEST_GPIO_VALUE_HIGH);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    /* 读回验证（回环测试或外部连接） */
    uint8_t val = 0;
    ret = GpioRead(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, &val);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(TEST_GPIO_VALUE_HIGH, val);

    GpioClose(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);
}

/**
 * @brief 验证 GPIO 完整生命周期
 */
static void TestGpioFullLifecycle(void) {
    /* Step 1: Open */
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, GpioOpen(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID));

    /* Step 2: Set Direction to Output */
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, GpioSetDir(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, GPIO_DIR_OUT));

    /* Step 3: Write High */
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, GpioWrite(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, 1));

    /* Step 4: Read back */
    uint8_t val = 0;
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, GpioRead(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, &val));
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(1, val);

    /* Step 5: Toggle */
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, GpioWrite(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, 0));
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, GpioRead(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, &val));
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(0, val);

    /* Step 6: Close */
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, GpioClose(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID));
}

/**
 * @brief 验证 GPIO 上下拉设置
 */
static void TestGpioSetPull(void) {
    GpioOpen(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);

    int32_t ret = GpioSetPull(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, GPIO_PULL_UP);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    GpioClose(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);
}
```

### 2.3 异常和边界测试

```c
/* gpio_driver_negative_test.c - Hi3861 GPIO异常测试 */
#include "gpio_driver_test.h"

/* ========== 异常测试 ========== */

/**
 * @brief 验证打开无效引脚返回错误
 */
static void TestGpioOpenInvalidPin(void) {
    int32_t ret = GpioOpen(TEST_GPIO_PIN_INVALID);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, ret);
}

/**
 * @brief 验证未打开时设置方向返回错误
 */
static void TestGpioSetDirUnopened(void) {
    int32_t ret = GpioSetDir(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, GPIO_DIR_OUT);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, ret);
}

/**
 * @brief 验证 Read 传入空指针返回错误
 */
static void TestGpioReadNullVal(void) {
    GpioOpen(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);

    int32_t ret = GpioRead(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, NULL);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, ret);

    GpioClose(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);
}

/**
 * @brief 验证关闭未打开的引脚不会崩溃
 */
static void TestGpioCloseUnopened(void) {
    int32_t ret = GpioClose(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);
    /* 不应崩溃，应返回错误或幂等成功 */
    TEST_ASSERT_TRUE(ret != 0 || ret == 0);
}

/**
 * @brief 验证重复打开同一引脚
 */
static void TestGpioDoubleOpen(void) {
    int32_t ret1 = GpioOpen(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret1);

    int32_t ret2 = GpioOpen(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);
    /* 根据规范，重复打开应返回 BUSY 或 SUCCESS（幂等） */
    TEST_ASSERT_TRUE(ret2 != 0 || ret2 == 0);

    GpioClose(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);
}

/**
 * @brief 验证注册中断时回调为空返回错误
 */
static void TestGpioSetIrqNullCallback(void) {
    GpioOpen(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);

    int32_t ret = GpioSetIrq(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, GPIO_IRQ_TRIGGER_RISING, NULL, NULL);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, ret);

    GpioClose(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);
}

/* ========== 边界值测试 ========== */

/**
 * @brief 验证设置无效的枚举方向值
 */
static void TestGpioSetDirInvalidEnum(void) {
    GpioOpen(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);

    int32_t ret = GpioSetDir(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID, (enum GpioDir)0xFF);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, ret);

    GpioClose(TEST_GPIO_PIN_VALID);
}

/**
 * @brief 验证引脚号为0时的行为
 */
static void TestGpioPinZero(void) {
    int32_t ret = GpioOpen(0);
    /* Hi3861 GPIO0可能有效也可能保留，取决于具体版本 */
    if (ret == 0) {
        GpioClose(0);
    }
}
```

### 2.4 测试入口

```c
/* test_entry.c - 测试主入口 */
#include "hctest.h"
#include "los_task.h"

extern void RunGpioTests(void);
extern void RunI2cTests(void);

static void TestTaskEntry(void) {
    printf("\n========================================\n");
    printf("  OpenHarmony Lite Driver Test Suite\n");
    printf("  Target: Hi3861 (L0 Mini System)\n");
    printf("========================================\n\n");

    RunGpioTests();
    RunI2cTests();

    printf("\n========================================\n");
    printf("  All tests completed.\n");
    printf("========================================\n");
}

void TestMain(void) {
    TSK_INIT_PARAM_S taskAttr = {0};
    taskAttr.pfnTaskEntry = (TSK_ENTRY_FUNC)TestTaskEntry;
    taskAttr.uwStackSize = 4096;  /* 4KB栈空间 */
    taskAttr.pcName = "TestTask";
    taskAttr.usTaskPrio = 10;

    uint32_t taskId;
    LOS_TaskCreate(&taskId, &taskAttr);
}
```

## 3. I2C 驱动测试示例（STM32F407）

```c
/* i2c_driver_test.c - STM32F407 I2C驱动测试 */
#include "hctest.h"
#include "i2c_if.h"

#define TEST_I2C_BUS_NUM       1    /* STM32F407 I2C1 */
#define TEST_I2C_DEV_ADDR      0x50 /* EEPROM AT24C02 */
#define TEST_I2C_FREQ_100K     100000
#define TEST_I2C_FREQ_400K     400000

static DevHandle g_i2cHandle = NULL;

static void TestI2cOpenClose(void) {
    DevHandle handle = I2cOpen(TEST_I2C_BUS_NUM);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    I2cClose(handle);
}

static void TestI2cSetFreq(void) {
    DevHandle handle = I2cOpen(TEST_I2C_BUS_NUM);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    int32_t ret = I2cSetFreq(handle, TEST_I2C_FREQ_400K);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    uint32_t freq = 0;
    ret = I2cGetFreq(handle, &freq);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT32(TEST_I2C_FREQ_400K, freq);

    I2cClose(handle);
}

static void TestI2cWriteRead(void) {
    DevHandle handle = I2cOpen(TEST_I2C_BUS_NUM);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    uint8_t writeData[] = {0x00, 0xAA, 0x55, 0xFF};

    int32_t ret = I2cWrite(handle, TEST_I2C_DEV_ADDR, writeData, sizeof(writeData));
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    uint8_t readBuf[4] = {0};
    ret = I2cRead(handle, TEST_I2C_DEV_ADDR, readBuf, sizeof(readBuf));
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT8(writeData[i], readBuf[i]);
    }

    I2cClose(handle);
}

static void TestI2cOpenInvalidBus(void) {
    DevHandle handle = I2cOpen(999);
    TEST_ASSERT_NULL(handle);
}

static void TestI2cWriteNullData(void) {
    DevHandle handle = I2cOpen(TEST_I2C_BUS_NUM);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    int32_t ret = I2cWrite(handle, TEST_I2C_DEV_ADDR, NULL, 4);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, ret);

    I2cClose(handle);
}

void RunI2cTests(void) {
    printf("\n=== I2C Driver Test Suite (STM32F407) ===\n");
    RUN_TEST(TestI2cOpenClose);
    RUN_TEST(TestI2cSetFreq);
    RUN_TEST(TestI2cWriteRead);
    RUN_TEST(TestI2cOpenInvalidBus);
    RUN_TEST(TestI2cWriteNullData);
}
```

## 4. UART 驱动测试示例（BES2600W）

```c
/* uart_driver_test.c - BES2600W UART驱动测试 */
#include "hctest.h"
#include "uart_if.h"
#include <string.h>

#define TEST_UART_PORT         1
#define TEST_UART_BAUD_115200  115200

static void TestUartOpenClose(void) {
    DevHandle handle = UartOpen(TEST_UART_PORT);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);
    UartClose(handle);
}

static void TestUartSetBaud(void) {
    DevHandle handle = UartOpen(TEST_UART_PORT);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    int32_t ret = UartSetBaud(handle, TEST_UART_BAUD_115200);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    uint32_t baud = 0;
    ret = UartGetBaud(handle, &baud);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_UINT32(TEST_UART_BAUD_115200, baud);

    UartClose(handle);
}

static void TestUartWriteReadLoopback(void) {
    DevHandle handle = UartOpen(TEST_UART_PORT);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    const char *testStr = "Hello OpenHarmony Lite!";
    size_t writeLen = strlen(testStr);

    int32_t written = UartWrite(handle, (uint8_t *)testStr, writeLen);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32((int32_t)writeLen, written);

    /* 回环测试需要TX-RX短接 */
    uint8_t readBuf[64] = {0};
    int32_t readLen = UartRead(handle, readBuf, sizeof(readBuf));
    TEST_ASSERT_GREATER_THAN(0, readLen);

    UartClose(handle);
}

static void TestUartWriteNullData(void) {
    DevHandle handle = UartOpen(TEST_UART_PORT);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    int32_t ret = UartWrite(handle, NULL, 10);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, ret);

    UartClose(handle);
}

void RunUartTests(void) {
    printf("\n=== UART Driver Test Suite (BES2600W) ===\n");
    RUN_TEST(TestUartOpenClose);
    RUN_TEST(TestUartSetBaud);
    RUN_TEST(TestUartWriteReadLoopback);
    RUN_TEST(TestUartWriteNullData);
}
```

## 5. SPI 驱动测试模板

```c
/* spi_driver_test.c - SPI驱动测试模板 */
#include "hctest.h"
#include "spi_if.h"

#define TEST_SPI_BUS_NUM       1
#define TEST_SPI_FREQ_1M       1000000

static void TestSpiOpenClose(void) {
    DevHandle handle = SpiOpen(TEST_SPI_BUS_NUM);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);
    SpiClose(handle);
}

static void TestSpiSetCfg(void) {
    DevHandle handle = SpiOpen(TEST_SPI_BUS_NUM);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    struct SpiCfg cfg = {0};
    cfg.mode = SPI_MODE_MASTER;
    cfg.transferMode = SPI_MODE_RD_WR;
    cfg.freq = TEST_SPI_FREQ_1M;

    int32_t ret = SpiSetCfg(handle, &cfg);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    SpiClose(handle);
}

static void TestSpiTransfer(void) {
    DevHandle handle = SpiOpen(TEST_SPI_BUS_NUM);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    uint8_t txBuf[] = {0x9F, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00};  /* JEDEC ID command */
    uint8_t rxBuf[4] = {0};

    struct SpiMsg msgs[] = {
        {.txBuf = txBuf, .rxBuf = rxBuf, .len = 4}
    };

    int32_t ret = SpiTransfer(handle, msgs, 1);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    SpiClose(handle);
}

static void TestSpiOpenInvalidBus(void) {
    DevHandle handle = SpiOpen(999);
    TEST_ASSERT_NULL(handle);
}

static void TestSpiTransferNullMsg(void) {
    DevHandle handle = SpiOpen(TEST_SPI_BUS_NUM);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    int32_t ret = SpiTransfer(handle, NULL, 1);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, ret);

    SpiClose(handle);
}

void RunSpiTests(void) {
    printf("\n=== SPI Driver Test Suite ===\n");
    RUN_TEST(TestSpiOpenClose);
    RUN_TEST(TestSpiSetCfg);
    RUN_TEST(TestSpiTransfer);
    RUN_TEST(TestSpiOpenInvalidBus);
    RUN_TEST(TestSpiTransferNullMsg);
}
```

## 6. ADC 驱动测试模板

```c
/* adc_driver_test.c - ADC驱动测试模板 */
#include "hctest.h"
#include "adc_if.h"

#define TEST_ADC_CHANNEL       0
#define TEST_ADC_CHANNEL_MAX   7
#define TEST_ADC_CHANNEL_INVALID 99

static void TestAdcOpenClose(void) {
    DevHandle handle = AdcOpen(TEST_ADC_CHANNEL);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);
    AdcClose(handle);
}

static void TestAdcReadChannel(void) {
    DevHandle handle = AdcOpen(TEST_ADC_CHANNEL);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    uint16_t value = 0;
    int32_t ret = AdcRead(handle, &value);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);
    /* ADC值应在0-4095范围内（12-bit ADC） */
    TEST_ASSERT_TRUE(value <= 4095);

    AdcClose(handle);
}

static void TestAdcReadNullValue(void) {
    DevHandle handle = AdcOpen(TEST_ADC_CHANNEL);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    int32_t ret = AdcRead(handle, NULL);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, ret);

    AdcClose(handle);
}

static void TestAdcOpenInvalidChannel(void) {
    DevHandle handle = AdcOpen(TEST_ADC_CHANNEL_INVALID);
    TEST_ASSERT_NULL(handle);
}

void RunAdcTests(void) {
    printf("\n=== ADC Driver Test Suite ===\n");
    RUN_TEST(TestAdcOpenClose);
    RUN_TEST(TestAdcReadChannel);
    RUN_TEST(TestAdcReadNullValue);
    RUN_TEST(TestAdcOpenInvalidChannel);
}
```

## 7. PWM 驱动测试模板

```c
/* pwm_driver_test.c - PWM驱动测试模板 */
#include "hctest.h"
#include "pwm_if.h"

#define TEST_PWM_PORT          0
#define TEST_PWM_PERIOD_US     1000  /* 1ms period = 1kHz */
#define TEST_PWM_DUTY_50       50    /* 50% duty cycle */

static void TestPwmOpenClose(void) {
    DevHandle handle = PwmOpen(TEST_PWM_PORT);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);
    PwmClose(handle);
}

static void TestPwmSetPeriodDuty(void) {
    DevHandle handle = PwmOpen(TEST_PWM_PORT);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    int32_t ret = PwmSetPeriod(handle, TEST_PWM_PERIOD_US);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    ret = PwmSetDuty(handle, TEST_PWM_DUTY_50);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    ret = PwmStart(handle);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    ret = PwmStop(handle);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);

    PwmClose(handle);
}

static void TestPwmSetDutyOutOfRange(void) {
    DevHandle handle = PwmOpen(TEST_PWM_PORT);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(handle);

    int32_t ret = PwmSetDuty(handle, 101);  /* > 100% */
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, ret);

    PwmClose(handle);
}

void RunPwmTests(void) {
    printf("\n=== PWM Driver Test Suite ===\n");
    RUN_TEST(TestPwmOpenClose);
    RUN_TEST(TestPwmSetPeriodDuty);
    RUN_TEST(TestPwmSetDutyOutOfRange);
}
```

## 8. CMSIS 接口兼容性测试

```c
/* cmsis_compatibility_test.c - CMSIS接口兼容性测试 */
#include "hctest.h"
#include "cmsis_os2.h"

static void TestCmsisOsKernelInit(void) {
    osStatus_t status = osKernelInitialize();
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(osOK, status);
}

static void TestCmsisOsTimerCreate(void) {
    osTimerId_t timer = osTimerNew(NULL, osTimerOnce, NULL, NULL);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(timer);

    osStatus_t status = osTimerDelete(timer);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(osOK, status);
}

static void TestCmsisOsSemaphore(void) {
    osSemaphoreId_t sem = osSemaphoreNew(1, 0, NULL);
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_NULL(sem);

    osStatus_t status = osSemaphoreRelease(sem);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(osOK, status);

    status = osSemaphoreAcquire(sem, 100);
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(osOK, status);

    osSemaphoreDelete(sem);
}

void RunCmsisTests(void) {
    printf("\n=== CMSIS Compatibility Test Suite ===\n");
    RUN_TEST(TestCmsisOsKernelInit);
    RUN_TEST(TestCmsisOsTimerCreate);
    RUN_TEST(TestCmsisOsSemaphore);
}
```

## 9. WiFi IoT API 测试模板（Hi3861/BES2600W）

```c
/* wifi_iot_test.c - WiFi IoT API测试模板 */
#include "hctest.h"
#include "iot_wifi.h"

static void TestWifiInit(void) {
    int32_t ret = IotWifiInit();
    TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_INT32(0, ret);
}

static void TestWifiScan(void) {
    IotWifiInit();
    
    int32_t ret = IotWifiScan(NULL, 0);
    /* 扫描可能需要较长时间，仅验证不崩溃 */
    TEST_ASSERT_TRUE(ret >= 0 || ret < 0);  /* 记录返回值即可 */
}

static void TestWifiConnectInvalidSsid(void) {
    IotWifiInit();
    
    IotWifiConnectParams params = {0};
    params.ssid = "NONEXISTENT_SSID_12345";
    params.key = "wrong_password";
    params.securityType = IOT_WIFI_SEC_TYPE_WPA2PSK;
    
    int32_t ret = IotWifiConnect(&params);
    /* 连接不存在的AP应返回失败 */
    TEST_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(0, ret);
}

void RunWifiTests(void) {
    printf("\n=== WiFi IoT Test Suite ===\n");
    RUN_TEST(TestWifiInit);
    RUN_TEST(TestWifiScan);
    RUN_TEST(TestWifiConnectInvalidSsid);
}
```

## 10. 支持的外设范围总览

| 外设类型 | HAL接口 | 核心测试点 | 优先级 | 适用系统 |
|---------|---------|-----------|--------|---------|
| **GPIO** | `gpio_if.h` | SetDir/Read/Write/SetPull/SetIrq | P0 | L0/L1 |
| **I2C** | `i2c_if.h` | Open/Close/Read/Write/SetFreq | P0 | L0/L1 |
| **SPI** | `spi_if.h` | Open/Close/Transfer/SetCfg | P0 | L0/L1 |
| **UART** | `uart_if.h` | Open/Close/Read/Write/SetBaud | P0 | L0/L1 |
| **ADC** | `adc_if.h` | Open/Close/ReadChannel | P1 | L0/L1 |
| **PWM** | `pwm_if.h` | Open/Close/SetPeriod/SetDuty | P1 | L0/L1 |
| **RTC** | `rtc_if.h` | GetTime/SetTime | P1 | L0/L1 |
| **Watchdog** | `watchdog_if.h` | Start/Stop/SetTimeout | P2 | L0/L1 |
| **WiFi** | IoT WiFi API | Scan/Connect/Disconnect | P2 | L0(Hi3861/BES2600W) |
| **BLE** | IoT BLE API | Advertise/Connect/GATT | P2 | L0(Hi3861/BES2600W) |
| **Display** | Lite图形API | Init/DrawPixel/Flush | P2 | L0(BES2600W)/L1 |

## 12. GPIO 驱动 L1-Linux 测试示例（RK3568）

### 12.1 正向功能测试

```cpp
/* gpio_driver_test_l1.cpp - RK3568 GPIO驱动测试（L1-Linux HWTest） */
#include <gtest/gtest.h>
#include "gpio_if.h"

using namespace testing::ext;

namespace OHOS {

class GpioTest : public testing::Test {
public:
    static void SetUpTestCase(void) {}
    static void TearDownTestCase(void) {}
};

/**
 * @tc.name: GpioTestOpenClose
 * @tc.desc: 验证GPIO正常打开和关闭
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(GpioTest, TestGpioOpenClose, TestSize.Level0)
{
    int32_t ret = GpioOpen(5);
    EXPECT_EQ(0, ret);

    ret = GpioClose(5);
    EXPECT_EQ(0, ret);
}

/**
 * @tc.name: GpioTestSetDirInput
 * @tc.desc: 验证设置GPIO为输入方向
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(GpioTest, TestGpioSetDirInput, TestSize.Level0)
{
    GpioOpen(5);

    int32_t ret = GpioSetDir(5, GPIO_DIR_IN);
    EXPECT_EQ(0, ret);

    enum GpioDir dir;
    ret = GpioGetDir(5, &dir);
    EXPECT_EQ(0, ret);
    EXPECT_EQ(GPIO_DIR_IN, dir);

    GpioClose(5);
}

/**
 * @tc.name: GpioTestWriteRead
 * @tc.desc: 验证设置GPIO为输出方向并写入读取
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(GpioTest, TestGpioWriteRead, TestSize.Level0)
{
    GpioOpen(5);
    GpioSetDir(5, GPIO_DIR_OUT);

    int32_t ret = GpioWrite(5, 1);
    EXPECT_EQ(0, ret);

    uint8_t val = 0;
    ret = GpioRead(5, &val);
    EXPECT_EQ(0, ret);
    EXPECT_EQ(1, val);

    GpioClose(5);
}

/**
 * @tc.name: GpioTestFullLifecycle
 * @tc.desc: 验证GPIO完整生命周期
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(GpioTest, TestGpioFullLifecycle, TestSize.Level0)
{
    EXPECT_EQ(0, GpioOpen(5));
    EXPECT_EQ(0, GpioSetDir(5, GPIO_DIR_OUT));
    EXPECT_EQ(0, GpioWrite(5, 1));

    uint8_t val = 0;
    EXPECT_EQ(0, GpioRead(5, &val));
    EXPECT_EQ(1, val);

    EXPECT_EQ(0, GpioWrite(5, 0));
    EXPECT_EQ(0, GpioRead(5, &val));
    EXPECT_EQ(0, val);

    EXPECT_EQ(0, GpioClose(5));
}

} // namespace OHOS
```

### 12.2 异常和边界测试

```cpp
/* gpio_driver_negative_test_l1.cpp - RK3568 GPIO异常测试（L1-Linux HWTest） */
#include <gtest/gtest.h>
#include "gpio_if.h"

using namespace testing::ext;

namespace OHOS {

class GpioNegativeTest : public testing::Test {
public:
    static void SetUpTestCase(void) {}
    static void TearDownTestCase(void) {}
};

/**
 * @tc.name: GpioTestOpenInvalidPin
 * @tc.desc: 验证打开无效引脚返回错误
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(GpioNegativeTest, TestGpioOpenInvalidPin, TestSize.Level1)
{
    int32_t ret = GpioOpen(999);
    EXPECT_NE(0, ret);
}

/**
 * @tc.name: GpioTestSetDirUnopened
 * @tc.desc: 验证未打开时设置方向返回错误
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(GpioNegativeTest, TestGpioSetDirUnopened, TestSize.Level1)
{
    int32_t ret = GpioSetDir(5, GPIO_DIR_OUT);
    EXPECT_NE(0, ret);
}

/**
 * @tc.name: GpioTestReadNullVal
 * @tc.desc: 验证Read传入空指针返回错误
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(GpioNegativeTest, TestGpioReadNullVal, TestSize.Level1)
{
    GpioOpen(5);

    int32_t ret = GpioRead(5, nullptr);
    EXPECT_NE(0, ret);

    GpioClose(5);
}

/**
 * @tc.name: GpioTestDoubleOpen
 * @tc.desc: 验证重复打开同一引脚的行为
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(GpioNegativeTest, TestGpioDoubleOpen, TestSize.Level1)
{
    int32_t ret1 = GpioOpen(5);
    EXPECT_EQ(0, ret1);

    int32_t ret2 = GpioOpen(5);
    // 根据规范，重复打开应返回 BUSY 或 SUCCESS（幂等）
    EXPECT_TRUE(ret2 == 0 || ret2 != 0);

    GpioClose(5);
}

/**
 * @tc.name: GpioTestSetDirInvalidEnum
 * @tc.desc: 验证设置无效的枚举方向值
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(GpioNegativeTest, TestGpioSetDirInvalidEnum, TestSize.Level1)
{
    GpioOpen(5);

    int32_t ret = GpioSetDir(5, static_cast<enum GpioDir>(0xFF));
    EXPECT_NE(0, ret);

    GpioClose(5);
}

/**
 * @tc.name: GpioTestSetIrqNullCallback
 * @tc.desc: 验证注册中断时回调为空返回错误
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(GpioNegativeTest, TestGpioSetIrqNullCallback, TestSize.Level1)
{
    GpioOpen(5);

    int32_t ret = GpioSetIrq(5, GPIO_IRQ_TRIGGER_RISING, nullptr, nullptr);
    EXPECT_NE(0, ret);

    GpioClose(5);
}

} // namespace OHOS
```

## 13. I2C 驱动 L1-Linux 测试示例

```cpp
/* i2c_driver_test_l1.cpp - I2C驱动测试（L1-Linux HWTest） */
#include <gtest/gtest.h>
#include "i2c_if.h"

using namespace testing::ext;

namespace OHOS {

#define TEST_I2C_BUS_NUM       1
#define TEST_I2C_DEV_ADDR      0x50
#define TEST_I2C_FREQ_400K     400000

class I2cTest : public testing::Test {
public:
    static void SetUpTestCase(void) {}
    static void TearDownTestCase(void) {}
};

/**
 * @tc.name: I2cTestOpenClose
 * @tc.desc: 验证I2C正常打开和关闭
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(I2cTest, TestI2cOpenClose, TestSize.Level0)
{
    DevHandle handle = I2cOpen(TEST_I2C_BUS_NUM);
    EXPECT_NE(nullptr, handle);
    I2cClose(handle);
}

/**
 * @tc.name: I2cTestSetFreq
 * @tc.desc: 验证设置I2C频率
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(I2cTest, TestI2cSetFreq, TestSize.Level0)
{
    DevHandle handle = I2cOpen(TEST_I2C_BUS_NUM);
    ASSERT_NE(nullptr, handle);

    int32_t ret = I2cSetFreq(handle, TEST_I2C_FREQ_400K);
    EXPECT_EQ(0, ret);

    uint32_t freq = 0;
    ret = I2cGetFreq(handle, &freq);
    EXPECT_EQ(0, ret);
    EXPECT_EQ(TEST_I2C_FREQ_400K, freq);

    I2cClose(handle);
}

/**
 * @tc.name: I2cTestWriteRead
 * @tc.desc: 验证I2C读写操作
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(I2cTest, TestI2cWriteRead, TestSize.Level0)
{
    DevHandle handle = I2cOpen(TEST_I2C_BUS_NUM);
    ASSERT_NE(nullptr, handle);

    uint8_t writeData[] = {0x00, 0xAA, 0x55, 0xFF};
    int32_t ret = I2cWrite(handle, TEST_I2C_DEV_ADDR, writeData, sizeof(writeData));
    EXPECT_EQ(0, ret);

    uint8_t readBuf[4] = {0};
    ret = I2cRead(handle, TEST_I2C_DEV_ADDR, readBuf, sizeof(readBuf));
    EXPECT_EQ(0, ret);

    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        EXPECT_EQ(writeData[i], readBuf[i]);
    }

    I2cClose(handle);
}

/**
 * @tc.name: I2cTestOpenInvalidBus
 * @tc.desc: 验证打开无效总线返回错误
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(I2cTest, TestI2cOpenInvalidBus, TestSize.Level1)
{
    DevHandle handle = I2cOpen(999);
    EXPECT_EQ(nullptr, handle);
}

/**
 * @tc.name: I2cTestWriteNullData
 * @tc.desc: 验证Write传入空数据返回错误
 * @tc.type: FUNC
 */
HWTEST_F(I2cTest, TestI2cWriteNullData, TestSize.Level1)
{
    DevHandle handle = I2cOpen(TEST_I2C_BUS_NUM);
    ASSERT_NE(nullptr, handle);

    int32_t ret = I2cWrite(handle, TEST_I2C_DEV_ADDR, nullptr, 4);
    EXPECT_NE(0, ret);

    I2cClose(handle);
}

} // namespace OHOS
```

## 14. L1-Linux（HWTest 模式）BUILD.gn 编译配置模板

```gn
# BUILD.gn - L1-Linux HWTest 驱动测试编译配置
import("//build/lite/config/component/lite_component.gni")

local_flags = [
  "-fpermissive",
  "-O2",
  "-fbuiltin",
  "-Wno-narrowing",
  "-fPIE",
  "-Wno-error",
]

# 冒烟测试配置（仅Level0）
config("public_config_for_smoke") {
  cflags = [ "-DLOSCFG_USER_TEST_SMOKE" ]
  cflags += local_flags
  cflags_cc = cflags
}

# 完整测试配置（Level0 + Level1）
config("public_config_for_all") {
  cflags = [
    "-DLOSCFG_USER_TEST_SMOKE",
    "-DLOSCFG_USER_TEST_FULL",
  ]
  cflags += local_flags
  cflags_cc = cflags
}

group("unittest") {
  deps = []
  if (ohos_build_type == "debug") {
    # 冒烟测试（快速验证）
    deps += [ ":{{driver_name}}_test_smoke" ]
    # 完整测试
    deps += [ ":{{driver_name}}_test_full" ]
  }
}

# 冒烟测试可执行文件
executable("{{driver_name}}_test_smoke") {
  sources = [
    "{{driver_name}}_test.cpp",
    "{{driver_name}}_negative_test.cpp",
  ]

  configs = [ ":public_config_for_smoke" ]

  include_dirs = [
    "//drivers/framework/framework/include/platform",
    "//kernel/liteos_a/testsuites/include",
  ]

  deps = [
    "//kernel/liteos_a:liteos_a",
  ]

  cflags_cc = [ "-std=c++14" ]
}

# 完整测试可执行文件
executable("{{driver_name}}_test_full") {
  sources = [
    "{{driver_name}}_test.cpp",
    "{{driver_name}}_negative_test.cpp",
    "{{driver_name}}_boundary_test.cpp",
    "{{driver_name}}_stress_test.cpp",
  ]

  configs = [ ":public_config_for_all" ]

  include_dirs = [
    "//drivers/framework/framework/include/platform",
    "//kernel/liteos_a/testsuites/include",
  ]

  deps = [
    "//kernel/liteos_a:liteos_a",
  ]

  cflags_cc = [ "-std=c++14" ]
}
```

## 15. L0 vs L1-Linux 测试模式对照表

| 维度 | L0（HCTest + iCunit 混合模式） | L1-Linux（HWTest / gtest 模式；L1-LiteOS-A 按平台 acts 范式确认） |
|------|-------------------------------|--------------------------|
| **语言** | 纯C | C++（c++14） |
| **头文件** | `#include "hctest.h"` | `#include <gtest/gtest.h>` |
| **套件声明** | `LITE_TEST_SUIT(Sub, Mod, Suite);` | `class Suite : public testing::Test {};` |
| **用例定义** | `LITE_TEST_CASE(Suite, name, flag) { ... }` | `HWTEST_F(Suite, Name, TestSize.Level0) { ... }` |
| **运行入口** | `RUN_TEST_SUITE(Suite);` | 自动注册（gtest引擎） |
| **相等断言** | `ICUNIT_ASSERT_EQUAL(a, b, retcode)` | `EXPECT_EQ(expected, actual)` |
| **不等断言** | `ICUNIT_ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL(a, b, retcode)` | `EXPECT_NE(val1, val2)` |
| **空指针断言** | 无专用宏，用 `ICUNIT_ASSERT_EQUAL(ptr, NULL, ptr)` | `EXPECT_EQ(nullptr, ptr)` |
| **SetUp/TearDown** | `static BOOL SuiteSetUp(void)` 返回TRUE/FALSE | `void SetUp() override` + `static void SetUpTestCase()` |
| **测试标签** | `Function \| MediumTest \| Level1` | `TestSize.Level0` |
| **条件编译** | 无（全量编译） | `#if defined(LOSCFG_USER_TEST_SMOKE)` |
| **命名空间** | 无 | `namespace OHOS { ... }` |
| **Doxygen注释** | `@tc.desc` 可选 | `@tc.name` / `@tc.desc` / `@tc.type: FUNC` 必须 |
| **失败输出** | `[Failed]-name-[Errline: 156 RetCode:0x1]` | `GpioTest.TestOpen (2 ms) FAILED` |
| **RAM开销** | ~2-4KB | ~64KB+ |
| **自动执行** | 系统启动后自动运行 | 由gtest main()触发 |
